newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to sell telecom specifications from May 5.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to sell telecom specifications from May 5.

text.p: Ecuador said Wednesday that tender specifications for the privatization of 35 percent of telecommunications firm Emetel will go on sale May 5.
A privatization data room will be available from May 19.
The sale is due to go ahead in August or September.
U.S. firms MCI and GTE, Italy's Stet, Spain's Telefonica de Espana and Korea Telecom presented their credentials to bid in the privatization last November.
The government, which plans to split Emetel in two after the privatization, has still to decide whether Emetel's $400 million debt will be transferred to the new operators.
The government of former President Abdala Bucaram said it hoped to garner $1 billion from the Emetel sale.
